mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 2.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 195.0, it indicates an inflationary shock despite low rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 195.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, housing starts below 2000.0 units signal an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST < 2000.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply chain strength above INDPRO 115.0 indicates robust economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO > 115.0 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 2000.0 units signal weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 2000.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales exceed 350000.0 million dollars and the federal funds rate is below 2.5%, it indicates a weak economy with low policy rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS > 350000.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (PAYEMS > 132000.0 thousand persons), strong employment growth signals sustained economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during labor market tightness (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).
